visual_review.notes: Autonomous review of all 868 original chronological H3 frames, enlarged identity/alpha/equipment details, every native 128px phase and three battle-shell phases. Reciprocal gait, bow-shove anticipation/contact/recovery, one ranged draw/release/recovery, upright recoil, held crouched defense, physical hand/strap support signal and continuous grounded collapse retain original design, bow, goggles and winter clothes. Excluded unstable opening arrow handling by selecting the clean nocked stance; detached flying arrow separated across empty gaps in two release frames because runtime owns flight. Preserved eight reviewed articulated idle paintings and map timing. 271 selected original frames; no interpolated, reversed or duplicate padding. Candidate 913 focused checks passed. This is chronological-frame and native-phase review, not continuous browser playback or a manual game playtest.
